title: CBS Baseline Snapshot
description: Frozen snapshot of CBS state for YoY growth tracking. Once captured for a given snapshot_date, this file does not change.

_doc.description: Human-readable note explaining the baseline's purpose and immutability.

_schema_version.description: Semver of the baseline schema. Bump on breaking changes.

snapshot_date.description: The date this baseline represents (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

snapshot_generated_at.description: When the snapshot was generated (ISO timestamp, UTC).

source_cbs_files.description: CBS files that were read to compose this baseline.

bank_aggregates.description: Bank-wide aggregates. Always populated when CBS aggregate JSONs are present. Optional 'from_accounts_csv' sub-key when accounts.csv was available.

per_rm.description: Per-RM portfolio snapshots, keyed by rm_code. Empty {} if accounts.csv was absent.

per_branch.description: Per-branch portfolio snapshots, keyed by branch_code. Empty {} if accounts.csv was absent.
